card.name: Odd 'ln' and 'lg' pieces inside words
card.fires_on: The short letter chunks 'ln' or 'lg' when they fall partway through a longer word, name or web code. Examples are 'ln' in a brand name, 'lg' in triacylglycerols, or 'ln' in a place name.

modes.label: ln inside a word
modes.description: The chunk 'ln' sits inside a brand name, body-part name, place name or web code.

modes.label: lg inside a word
modes.description: The chunk 'lg' appears inside the long chemical word triacylglycerols or a similar split word.

card.plain: It fires on a small letter pair like 'ln' or 'lg' tucked inside the middle of an unusual or split-up word.
